say:0:1221601001:0.text: Hey, stop loafing around! Get back to work!
say:0:1221601001:0.source_cn: 喂，你们！别闲逛了，快回来干活！
say:0:1221601001:0.male: Hey, stop loafing around! Get back to work!
say:0:1221601001:0.female: Hey, stop loafing around! Get back to work!

say:1:1221601002:0.source_cn: 瞎看什么！就是你们，快过来！

say:2:1221603001:1.text: Seriously, you newbies are unbelievable! Slacking off really comes naturally to you guys, huh?
say:2:1221603001:1.source_cn: 唉，你们这几个新来的真没眼色！别的不学，偷懒倒是无师自通！

say:3:1221603002:1.text: Newbies? Slack off? What are you talking about, Sir?
say:3:1221603002:1.source_cn: 新来的？偷懒？大叔，你在说什么啊？

say:4:1221603003:1.text: Still playing dumb? Don't think you can get away with being lazy because you look cute... Ugh, how on earth did I end up with these hopeless new recruits?
say:4:1221603003:1.source_cn: 还装傻？别以为你长得可爱就可以少干活……唉，怎么又招了...

say:5:1221603004:1.text: There are only a few of us in this entire workshop, so don't even think about slacking off.
say:5:1221603004:1.source_cn: 整个百炼工坊里搞勤务的就咱们几个人，你可别想混日子。

choice_prompt:6:1221603004.text: There are only a few of us in this entire workshop, so don't even think about slacking off.
choice_prompt:6:1221603004.source_cn: 整个百炼工坊里搞勤务的就咱们几个人，你可别想混日子。

say:7:1221603005:1.text: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.
say:7:1221603005:1.source_cn: 不是勤务工是什么，难道你还能是当家的请来的贵客？
say:7:1221603005:1.male: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.
say:7:1221603005:1.female: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.

say:8:1221603007:1.text: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!
say:8:1221603007:1.source_cn: 你们别听其他人说什么能偷懒就偷懒，能少干就少干的，那都...
say:8:1221603007:1.male: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!
say:8:1221603007:1.female: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!

say:10:1221603009:1.text: No more buts! I have no time for your excuses! If you keep on loafing around, you'll get me in trouble too!
say:10:1221603009:1.source_cn: 别可是了，什么借口我都不听。再继续偷懒，别说你们了，连...

say:11:1221603010:1.text: Just look around! There's a pile of junk waiting to be sorted, weapons that need to be polished, and plenty of chores in the kitchen waiting to be done!
say:11:1221603010:1.source_cn: 你看看，一大堆的杂物没整理，武器没保养，厨房还等着我们帮忙！

say:12:1221603011:1.text: Now, come with me to <style="highlight">sort out the junk</style> first. Move it! Quick!
say:12:1221603011:1.source_cn: 你们先跟我去<style=highlight>整理杂物...

say:14:1221603006:1.text: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?
say:14:1221603006:1.source_cn: 这里就你们几个新人，我怎么会认错！
say:14:1221603006:1.male: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?
say:14:1221603006:1.female: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?

choice:6:1:2.text: You're mistaking us for somebody else.
choice:6:1:2.male: You're mistaking us for somebody else.
choice:6:1:2.female: You're mistaking us for somebody else.

say:0:1221604001:0.text: Hmph! Why can't he just hear us out?
say:0:1221604001:0.source_cn: 哼！他怎么就不能把我们的话听完呢。

say:1:1221604002:0.text: Let's go with what he says for now. We don't want any trouble.
say:1:1221604002:0.source_cn: 还是先听他的吧，现在最好别闹出太大动静。
say:1:1221604002:0.male: Let's go with what he says for now. We don't want any trouble.
say:1:1221604002:0.female: Let's go with what he says for now. We don't want any trouble.

say:0:1221605001:0.text: Look at this mess! Things are piled up everywhere!
say:0:1221605001:0.source_cn: 看看，东西堆得到处都是，乱七八糟的。

say:1:1221605002:0.text: Quick, tidy up this place now.
say:1:1221605002:0.source_cn: 快，先把这里的杂物收拾整齐。

say:0:1221606001:0.text: That was fast! Looks like you guys are pretty good at this.
say:0:1221606001:0.source_cn: 很麻利嘛，做得不错！你们收拾整理还挺有一套的。
say:0:1221606001:0.male: That was fast! Looks like you guys are pretty good at this.
say:0:1221606001:0.female: That was fast! Looks like you guys are pretty good at this.

say:1:1221606002:0.text: Next, let's take care of the weapons.
say:1:1221606002:0.source_cn: 好了，接下来该去保养武器了。
say:1:1221606002:0.male: Next, let's take care of the weapons.
say:1:1221606002:0.female: Next, let's take care of the weapons.

say:0:1221607001:0.text: You don't know how to do it? It's all about removing rust and oiling them...
say:0:1221607001:0.source_cn: 保养武器会不会？就是给武器除锈、擦油……
say:0:1221607001:0.male: You don't know how to do it? It's all about removing rust and oiling them...
say:0:1221607001:0.female: You don't know how to do it? It's all about removing rust and oiling them...

say:1:1221607002:0.text: Ah, I forgot about the oil. Go grab some here—one of each kind!
say:1:1221607002:0.source_cn: 哎呀，忘了拿保养油了，你们赶紧去拿，每种都拿一瓶啊！
say:1:1221607002:0.male: Ah, I forgot about the oil. Go grab some here—one of each kind!
say:1:1221607002:0.female: Ah, I forgot about the oil. Go grab some here—one of each kind!

say:0:1221608001:0.text: These should be enough. Let's head back.
say:0:1221608001:0.source_cn: 保养油应该够了，我们回去吧。

say:3:1221609001:1.text: Listen, our weapons easily get rusty because the sea's nearby. So, they need regular cleaning and maintenance.
say:3:1221609001:1.source_cn: 跟你们说，咱们这儿靠海，武器容易生锈，就得按时擦拭保养。

say:4:1221609002:1.text: If our weapons aren't in good shape when those Water Tights show up, we'll be in serious trouble.
say:4:1221609002:1.source_cn: 不然呐，咱们跟那什么死鬼帮一打起来，武器用着不顺手可就...

choice_prompt:5:1221609002.text: If our weapons aren't in good shape when those Water Tights show up, we'll be in serious trouble.
choice_prompt:5:1221609002.source_cn: 不然呐，咱们跟那什么死鬼帮一打起来，武器用着不顺手可就糟糕了。

say:6:1221609003:1.text: Oh, really? *Cough* You know what I mean anyway...
say:6:1221609003:1.source_cn: 啊？是吗？咳，反正都差不多……
say:6:1221609003:1.male: Oh, really? *Cough* You know what I mean anyway...
say:6:1221609003:1.female: Oh, really? *Cough* You know what I mean anyway...

say:7:1221609006:1.text: ...Ah, let me tell you more about weapon maintenance...
say:7:1221609006:1.source_cn: ……那个，我跟你们说说这个保养武器啊……
say:7:1221609006:1.male: ...Ah, let me tell you more about weapon maintenance...
say:7:1221609006:1.female: ...Ah, let me tell you more about weapon maintenance...

say:8:1221609007:1.text: That's an awkward way to change the subject...
say:8:1221609007:1.source_cn: 岔开话题的方式真是生硬呢……

say:9:1221609008:0.text: *Cough* Back to business. Apply the <style="highlight">cleaning oil</style>, <style="highlight">lubricating oil</style>, and <style="highlight">rust prevention oil</style> to the <style="highlight">rusty weapon</style> and rub all the rust off. That's it. Got it?

say:10:1221609009:0.text: Easy-peasy! Chippy's mastered it in a heartbeat!

document:11:50:0.text:
Maintenance Steps:
1. Remove dust and foreign matter from the surface of the <style="highlight">rusted iron sword</style>.
2. Apply <style="highlight">cleaning oil</style>, <style="highlight">lubricating oil</style>, and <style="highlight">rust prevention oil</style> in sequence to the surface, wiping repeatedly until the rust disappears.

Note: Use a clean, soft cloth or piece of leather when wiping.
document:11:50:0.source_cn:
武器保养方法
保养步骤：
第一步，将<style="highlight">生锈的铁剑</style>表面灰尘与杂物清理干净
第二步，在武器表面依次涂抹<style="highlight">清洁保养油</style>，<style="highlight">润滑保养油</style>，<style="highlight">防锈保养油</style>，反复擦拭至铁锈消失
注意：擦拭时需使用干净柔软的布料或皮革

Maintenance Steps:

2. Apply <style="highlight">cleaning oil</style>, <style="highlight">lubricating oil</style>, and <style="highlight">rust prevention oil</style> in sequence to the surface, wiping repeatedly until the rust disappears.

Note: Use a clean, soft cloth or piece of leather when wiping.

Note: Use a clean, soft cloth or piece of leather when wiping.

say:17:1221609011:0.text: Great work! Every weapon is gleaming. If only all my men were as hard-working as you...
say:17:1221609011:0.source_cn: 哎呀，真不错！每件武器都闪闪发亮。要是每个勤务工都像你...

say:18:1221609012:0.source_cn: 就是，我们做事从来不偷懒的！

say:19:1221609013:1.text: Alas, we laborers do all the dirty work, but we don't get paid well or be respected much.
say:19:1221609013:1.source_cn: 唉，其实吧，咱们做勤务的又没油水、又没地位，净干些打杂...

say:20:1221609014:1.text: While we handle most of the work, we get the least of the spoils. Even Sonja doesn't care about us... That's really—
say:20:1221609014:1.source_cn: 乱七八糟的活儿最多，可分战利品倒是咱们最少，老大也看不...

say:22:1221609016:0.text: Wow, I admire your energy! Actually, I get that everyone needs to relax every now and then, but some people aren't happy with it... Forget it, let's just keep going.
say:22:1221609016:0.source_cn: 哦，哦，你们很有精神，难得！其实大家偷懒我能理解，但其...

choice_prompt:23:1221609016.text: Wow, I admire your energy! Actually, I get that everyone needs to relax every now and then, but some people aren't happy with it... Forget it, let's just keep going.
choice_prompt:23:1221609016.source_cn: 哦，哦，你们很有精神，难得！其实大家偷懒我能理解，但其他兄弟不高兴啊……算了算了，不说了，咱们继续。

say:24:1221609017:0.text: Finished? What are you thinking? Our work never ends...
say:24:1221609017:0.source_cn: 结束？想什么呢，咱们的工作哪有结束的时候……
say:24:1221609017:0.male: Finished? What are you thinking? Our work never ends...
say:24:1221609017:0.female: Finished? What are you thinking? Our work never ends...

say:25:1221609018:0.text: It's almost time to <style="highlight">help out at the kitchen</style>. Come, I'll take you there.
say:25:1221609018:0.source_cn: 都这个点儿了，也差不多该去<style=highlig...

say:27:1221609004:0.text: Tsk, why do I need a good memory? I'm just a menial worker. Water Wights, Water Tights—it makes no difference for me.
say:27:1221609004:0.source_cn: 嗐，要那么好记性干什么，我做点杂事混口吃的，管他水鬼还...
say:27:1221609004:0.male: Tsk, why do I need a good memory? I'm just a menial worker. Water Wights, Water Tights—it makes no difference for me.
say:27:1221609004:0.female: Tsk, why do I need a good memory? I'm just a menial worker. Water Wights, Water Tights—it makes no difference for me.

say:28:1221609005:0.text: Well, tell us about your gang then. Is the name Carmine Whispers or Carbine Whispers?
say:28:1221609005:0.source_cn: 那你说说自己的帮派叫什么，血薇帮还是血玫帮？

choice:5:1:2.text: Your memory isn't very good, huh?
choice:5:1:2.male: Your memory isn't very good, huh?
choice:5:1:2.female: Your memory isn't very good, huh?

say:0:1221610001:0.text: Sir, is there no way to improve the benefits for laborers?
say:0:1221610001:0.source_cn: 大叔，就不能想办法提高勤务工的待遇吗？

say:1:1221610002:0.text: Well, it's all up to the higher-ups. I don't have any say in this even though I'm the foreman...
say:1:1221610002:0.source_cn: 唉，这得看上面，我就算是勤务工头子，也没那个本事啊……

say:0:1221611001:0.text: That guy over there is our chef. His face tells me there's more work coming our way...
say:0:1221611001:0.source_cn: 那个就是咱们这儿的厨师。看他那样子，咱们铁定又有事做了……

say:2:1221612001:0.text: Ah! You guys are here at the perfect time!
say:2:1221612001:0.source_cn: 哎呀，是你们，来得正好啊！

say:3:1221612002:0.text: The ducks have escaped again! Help me catch them and bring them back!
say:3:1221612002:0.source_cn: 快快快，鸭子又跑了，快帮我把那些鸭子都捉回来！

say:4:1221612003:0.text: Again? Fixing the fence seems to be more pressing if you ask me.
say:4:1221612003:0.source_cn: “又”跑了……你们应该修一个更好的围栏才是嘛。

say:5:1221612004:0.text: You've got a point! Please take care of it soon.
say:5:1221612004:0.source_cn: 说得对啊！那这个事你们勤务这两天安排一下。

say:7:1221612006:0.text: Oh boy, don't just stand there! Get the ducks!
say:7:1221612006:0.source_cn: 哎呀，别愣着了！快去抓鸭子啊！

say:3:1221613001:1.text: Phew... All the ducks are finally back. What an exhausting day for Chippy!
say:3:1221613001:1.source_cn: 呼……总算把鸭子都赶回来了。今天可真是累坏满满了！

choice_prompt:4:1221613001.text: Phew... All the ducks are finally back. What an exhausting day for Chippy!
choice_prompt:4:1221613001.source_cn: 呼……总算把鸭子都赶回来了。今天可真是累坏满满了！

say:6:1221613004:1.text: Now you know how hard we laborers work each day... Well, at least you can get things done quite efficiently.
say:6:1221613004:1.source_cn: 现在知道咱们勤务工每天有多辛苦了吧……唉，你们算是手脚...

say:7:1221613005:1.text: Come, let's take a breather while we can. We never know what comes next...
say:7:1221613005:1.source_cn: 来，趁现在没事，咱们去休息一会。谁知道接下来还有什么事...

say:9:1221613003:1.text: That's a good point... I'm a knight! I won't get tired so easily!
say:9:1221613003:1.source_cn: 也是……身为骑士，怎么能被这点小事累倒！
say:9:1221613003:1.male: That's a good point... I'm a knight! I won't get tired so easily!
say:9:1221613003:1.female: That's a good point... I'm a knight! I won't get tired so easily!

choice:4:1:2.text: Think of it as a workout.
choice:4:1:2.male: Think of it as a workout.
choice:4:1:2.female: Think of it as a workout.

say:2:1221615001:1.text: Those guys seem to be looking for us.
say:2:1221615001:1.source_cn: 咦，那些人说什么……在找勤务工？

say:3:1221615002:1.text: ...What do they need us for... We've done a fair share of work today.
say:3:1221615002:1.source_cn: ……找咱们干什么啊……咱们今天可是一点没偷懒。

say:4:1221615003:1.text: Oh, Dura and god of the waves above, I hope they aren't here to look for trouble...
say:4:1221615003:1.source_cn: 哎呦，艾雅也好，风浪与漂泊之神也行，总之神明保佑，千万...

choice_prompt:5:1221615003.text: Oh, Dura and god of the waves above, I hope they aren't here to look for trouble...
choice_prompt:5:1221615003.source_cn: 哎呦，艾雅也好，风浪与漂泊之神也行，总之神明保佑，千万别是来找麻烦的……

say:6:1221615004:1.text: *Sigh* Life's so tough... Alright, let's go.
say:6:1221615004:1.source_cn: 唉，这一天天的……走，咱们过去吧。

choice:5:0:1.text: Let's find out what they want.
choice:5:0:1.male: Let's find out what they want.
choice:5:0:1.female: Let's find out what they want.

say:3:1221616001:0.text: Look who's back! We've been waiting for you.
say:3:1221616001:0.source_cn: 回来了回来了，可算是等到人了。

say:4:1221616002:0.text: What... can I do for you? I've finished all the chores today... Well, if you need anything else, I'm happy to help too!
say:4:1221616002:0.source_cn: 有……什么事吗？今天的勤务应该都做好了……啊，要是还有...

say:5:1221616003:0.text: We're here to let you know you did a good job today!
say:5:1221616003:0.source_cn: 咱们兄弟可是专门来找你的。今天的勤务工作做得真是不错！

say:6:1221616004:0.text: So sorry! We'll work on it... Wait a minute. We did a good job?
say:6:1221616004:0.source_cn: 对不起对不起，我们一定改……诶？你说做得不错？

say:7:1221616005:0.text: Absolutely! We just came back from a skirmish with the Water Wights, and we were thrilled by what we saw!
say:7:1221616005:0.source_cn: 对啊！咱们和水鬼帮干了一架，刚才回来一看，可给咱们乐坏了！

say:8:1221616006:0.text: Everything is neatly arranged, and the weapons are all shiny. I heard you guys even helped round up the ducks!
say:8:1221616006:0.source_cn: 东西摆得整整齐齐，武器擦得闪闪发光。听说你们还去帮忙赶...

say:11:1221616007:0.text: You can surely take some credit for dinner tonight!
say:11:1221616007:0.source_cn: 今天的晚饭得算你们一份功劳！

say:12:1221616008:1.text: You're actually... here to praise us? I didn't expect that...
say:12:1221616008:1.source_cn: 你是说……你们是来夸我们的？真是没想到……

say:13:1221616009:0.text: Well, neither did we. You really did an excellent job today.
say:13:1221616009:0.source_cn: 嗐，我们也没想到啊。你们今天可真是干得漂亮。

say:14:1221616010:0.text: This is great... We finally get more attention from you guys...
say:14:1221616010:0.source_cn: 哦……要是兄弟们多关心关心我们，我们也满足了……

choice_prompt:15:1221616010.text: This is great... We finally get more attention from you guys...
choice_prompt:15:1221616010.source_cn: 哦……要是兄弟们多关心关心我们，我们也满足了……

say:16:1221616011:0.text: Yeah, everyone thought you should get paid less since you weren't involved in the fights, but I just realized you are responsible for many other stuff.
say:16:1221616011:0.source_cn: 可不是，以前觉得你们不打架就该少分钱……唉，其实你们干...

say:17:1221616012:0.text: I'll talk to the higher-ups about this. We're going to meet Lucca tomorrow!
say:17:1221616012:0.source_cn: 这件事儿得跟上头的人说，明天我们就去找二当家！

say:18:1221616015:0.text: Wow... I don't even know what to say... This is great...
say:18:1221616015:0.source_cn: 这……这真是，我都不知道怎么说……真是太好了……

say:21:1221616016:0.text: So glad to see the changes we bring!
say:21:1221616016:0.source_cn: 大家能这么想，证明我们没有白干活。太棒了！

say:25:1221616013:0.text: I'm not good with words, you know? Usually get things done with my fists. Please bear with me, friend.
say:25:1221616013:0.source_cn: 我是个粗人，光会打架，不会讲话，兄弟多担待啊。

say:28:1221616014:0.text: Sorry, we shouldn't have bossed you around...
say:28:1221616014:0.source_cn: 怪我们，以前不该对你们这么呼来喝去的……

say:0:1221617001:0.source_cn: 雅克，刚才……到底是怎么回事？

say:1:1221617002:0.text: I... I was so scared to see them that I hid somewhere immediately.
say:1:1221617002:0.source_cn: 他们一来，我……我就吓得躲起来了……

say:3:1221618001:0.text: Those guys were shouting for us at the door earlier, but I was too scared to meet them. They were here to...?
say:3:1221618001:0.source_cn: 刚才那帮兄弟在门口喊了半天，我也不敢出来。他们是来……

choice_prompt:4:1221618001.text: Those guys were shouting for us at the door earlier, but I was too scared to meet them. They were here to...?
choice_prompt:4:1221618001.source_cn: 刚才那帮兄弟在门口喊了半天，我也不敢出来。他们是来……

say:5:1221618002:0.text: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...
say:5:1221618002:0.source_cn: 啊？不是吧！我就是稍微休息了一会……毕竟每天那么多活儿……
say:5:1221618002:0.male: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...
say:5:1221618002:0.female: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...

say:6:1221618003:0.text: Short break? I haven't seen you work all day! Isn't it a bit late to start worrying about the consequences?
say:6:1221618003:0.source_cn: “休息一会”？我可是一天都没看见你干活！现在知道害怕了？

say:8:1221618007:0.text: The truth is, they were here to compliment our outstanding work today.
say:8:1221618007:0.source_cn: 其实，他们刚刚是在夸我们，说我们今天的工作很出色。

say:11:1221618008:0.text: Outstanding work? W—We got a compliment?!
say:11:1221618008:0.source_cn: 工作出色？我们……我们被表扬了？

say:12:1221618009:0.text: Even though you didn't do the work... but yes, we got a compliment! That's the first since I've been here!
say:12:1221618009:0.source_cn: 虽然干活的人不是你们……但没错，咱们勤务工被表扬了！这...

say:13:1221618010:1.text: They are determined to fight for better pay for you all. Plus, they promised to stop bossing you around!
say:13:1221618010:1.source_cn: 他们打算帮你们争取更多的工钱。对了，还说不会再对你们呼...

say:16:1221618011:0.text: ...That's wonderful! We only slack off because we're exhausted, underpaid, and get beat up if we don't do things right.
say:16:1221618011:0.source_cn: ……太好了！我们偷懒，还不是因为又累又没钱，干不好还会被骂。

say:19:1221618012:0.text: Exactly. We'll be more motivated if they appreciate our hard work.
say:19:1221618012:0.source_cn: 对啊，要是大家能看到我们的辛苦，我们也不会一点干劲都没有。

choice_prompt:20:1221618012.text: Exactly. We'll be more motivated if they appreciate our hard work.
choice_prompt:20:1221618012.source_cn: 对啊，要是大家能看到我们的辛苦，我们也不会一点干劲都没有。

say:21:1221618013:0.text: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!
say:21:1221618013:0.source_cn: 是啊，以后的日子可有盼头多了！
say:21:1221618013:0.male: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!
say:21:1221618013:0.female: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!

say:22:1221618014:0.text: Actually, I've been wondering who these guys are. Are they our guests?
say:22:1221618014:0.source_cn: 对了，我刚才就想问，他们几个是谁，是我们的客人吗？

say:23:1221618015:0.text: Them? They are the new recruits.
say:23:1221618015:0.source_cn: 他们？他们是新来的勤务工啊！

say:26:1221618016:0.text: But... Lucca said yesterday that the new recruits would only arrive tomorrow...
say:26:1221618016:0.source_cn: 可是……昨儿我听二当家说，新人要明天才能到呢……

say:30:1221618017:0.text: We already told you we didn't work here, but you dragged us off to work without hearing us out!
say:30:1221618017:0.source_cn: 我们早就说过不是啦，可大叔你根本就不听，抓着我们就去干活了！

say:31:1221618018:0.text: Huh? Goodness gracious, I—I feel so bad for making you work all day...
say:31:1221618018:0.source_cn: 啊？哎呀，这……这可怎么好意思，让你们忙活了一整天……

choice_prompt:32:1221618018.text: Huh? Goodness gracious, I—I feel so bad for making you work all day...
choice_prompt:32:1221618018.source_cn: 啊？哎呀，这……这可怎么好意思，让你们忙活了一整天……

say:33:1221618019:1.text: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!
say:33:1221618019:1.source_cn: 主人说得对！能解决这么大的问题，我们也很满足呢！
say:33:1221618019:1.male: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!
say:33:1221618019:1.female: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!

say:34:1221618021:1.text: Goodbye, Sir! I hope you won't take us as laborers again next time we meet!
say:34:1221618021:1.source_cn: 再见啦大叔，下次可不要不由分说就把我们当成勤务工啦！

say:35:1221618022:1.text: Thanks... Let me give you a proper welcome next time!
say:35:1221618022:1.source_cn: 谢谢……下次再见，我们一定会好好招待你们的！

choice:32:0:1.text: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.
choice:32:0:1.male: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.
choice:32:0:1.female: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.

say:37:1221618020:1.text: The takeaway of this is: Life is an exhausting but fulfilling journey!
say:37:1221618020:1.source_cn: 体验心得是：虽然生活很累，但也很有成就感！

say:38:1221618004:0.text: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...
say:38:1221618004:0.source_cn: 什么？怎么可能！他们不骂我们偷懒就不错了……
say:38:1221618004:0.male: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...
say:38:1221618004:0.female: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...

say:39:1221618005:1.text: So you actually know you're being lazy!
say:39:1221618005:1.source_cn: 原来你也知道自己在偷懒呀！
